__doc: Floors per set and model for the share of known bugs reaching this step kept, with the step's control checks (run.js --gate), as ratios. controlled: the snapshot's PRs of the finder's controlled set, the nightly and every tier-0 model's weekly run; full: every snapshot PR, on demand, no floor.
floor = min(mean - 2 binomial SE, (n - 2) / n) over the n checks of one run, rounded down: a pair of perfect runs still leaves room for 2 checks, like evals/conversation/targets.json.
